description: In the Sarine gorge at Fribourg, the covered wooden Pont de Berne crosses low over the river on a stone pier, while the 1924 Zähringen bridge spans the cliffs high above it. Houses hold to the rock between the two crossings. The cathedral on the upper hill is not this subject. The Open-Meteo model is broken cloud and mild, with no rain.
